description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. This indoor dataset records I/Q signals for selected transmitter and receiver beam-index pairs in the 60 GHz band. The experiment uses RFSoC 2x2 boards and Sivers EVK06002 equipment. Measurements are indexed by transmitter antenna-weight-vector selection, receiver selection, position and frequency. Processed physical-layer protocol data units are described. The provider identifies link-level analysis, beamforming optimisation and connectivity studies as applications. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. Access links are supplied on the provider landing page. Licence, cost and access requirements remain uncertain for the linked release. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Millimetre-wave link analysis and beamforming optimisation. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
